content.description: Alpha Surfers presents itself as a non-traditional investment bank that organizes its activity around investment funds, research, trade ideas, and education. The group explains that its model is meant to break away from fee-driven structures by aligning outcomes around the performance of its own investments. On its official site, Alpha Surfers frames the project around the values of Learn, Earn, Grow, and Share, positioning the community as financially aware, growth oriented, and focused on collective progress rather than traditional gatekeeping.
